title: Ahead of the Patient
treatment: Winner A (the Comedian, Ping) with grafts from C (the Explainer: the split-screen of a gurney token still on the dashed line while Anchorage's room is already lit, the brass brain-cell counter), B (the Dramatist: the button pulls back through the CT ring so the last frame rhymes with the first) and D (the Enthusiast: the dashed OUTCOMES row, six separate hospital vignettes lighting for keep and pay). Case one is an unplaced Alaska hospital (a CT room, a reading room, a lightbox, a wall phone). Case two is a DIFFERENT hospital in the interior (its own exterior doors in the blue before sunrise, its own intake board, desk phone and slow faceless report printer). Then a records shelf, a doctor's desk, six separate hospital vignettes, a long dusk horizon of Alaska, and the Anchorage stroke room. Ping, a round faced orchid alert pulse born in the CT ring, is the protagonist: it reads, flags, splits into two identical copies, races ahead of the patient, gets checked by a doctor's pen, and ends trying to hang its stopwatch on a RESULTS nail where an empty dashed scoreboard waits. Revised after Gate 0B/0C/0D round 1: Ping is a round pulse, not a card; orchid replaces coral; the clot is drawn as a vessel cutoff with a tiny ruby marker; the second case has its own world and its own printer and phone with no orchid on them; the specialists never sit on the map; the split race is a general diagram after the case; the network is a horizon, not a third map; the six hospitals are six separate vignettes.

roles.room: #CFE3D8 CT-room celadon tile with #9DBFB2 grout shade and #E9F1EC lit tile, a #1F3438 graphite-teal ink for the dark room and outlines, #2D4660 steel-blue winter dark through windows with two warm sodium points far off
roles.lightbox: #F4F1E6 bone-white lightbox and scanner glow is the KEY light, cool, never blue-white
roles.hero: Ping is the ONLY orchid #D94FB0 in the film, with a #F3A6DC lit face, #9C2C7E shade and a #FCE3F3 rim; hue about 318 degrees, about 50 degrees from 11-24's vermilion #EE4A24 (11) and 11-23's scarlet #E0303F (357), and about 280 degrees round the wheel from 11-25's amber #F2A93B (38)
roles.brain: CT slices are greyscale with a BRIGHT bone vessel tree; the occlusion is drawn as a cutoff where one bright vessel stops and the branch beyond goes grey, with a tiny ruby #B3223A marker keylined in 3 px ink at the cutoff (the darkest value in the slice, so it reads in greyscale and to protan and deutan viewers); ruby belongs to the marker only
roles.anchorage: the Anchorage stroke room is buttercream #EBDDBF walls at about L* 85 with walnut-brown #8C6B4E trim and a warm bulb #FFE9D6; no pink, so orchid Ping reads against it
roles.paper: #EFE7D2 report paper and map board, #3A3A36 mono print
roles.accent_rule: orchid is Ping and its copies ONLY (the reticle is bone, the OUTCOMES row reads by value, graphite dashes on bone, never a glow); ruby is the cutoff marker ONLY; the second hospital's phone and printer carry no orchid

palette.mood: a quiet hospital at 7 a.m. in the dark, clean, warm-hearted and a little funny; the joke is that the news always beats the paperwork
palette.divergence: 11-25 was a hard low noon sun on bone snow with signal amber (38 deg) and a faceless cast-iron hero outdoors; 11-24 was flat July overcast on olive tundra with vermilion (11 deg) pins; 11-23 was apricot-plum dusk on river ice with scarlet (357 deg). This is the first screen-lit hospital INTERIOR in four films: celadon and graphite under an ivory lightbox key, with orchid (318 deg) reserved for one round faced character. Hue distance from the nearest recent accent is about 39 degrees (11-23 scarlet) and 53 degrees (11-24 vermilion).

light.time_of_day: before dawn on a November morning, about 7 a.m., still dark outside

light.ping_keyline: in anchorage-room and the split-race right half Ping gets a 3 px graphite-teal keyline outside its ink

shape_language: Ping is a soft round pulse that squashes and stretches. The hospital is hard: square tiles, a rectilinear printer, the map grid, the strict scoreboard rows. The circle is the motif: the CT ring opens the film, Ping and the stopwatch rhyme with it, and the button pulls back out through the ring.

casting.hero: Ping (NET-NEW, lib/ping.tsx): a round orchid pulse the size of a fist, a soft bead with a ripple halo and a face set inside the glow, stubby arms; NO card or document silhouette, no belly thumbnail; emotion sleepy/alert/proud/determined/sheepish/deflated/hopeful/curious; split 0..1 divides it like a cell; a small hanging RAPIDAI plate when named; cues. Why: the AI here is software that reads a scan and sends an alert, so the alert is the character; round puts it in the circle family of the CT ring and the stopwatch.
casting.net_new_supporting: CTRing (no CT scanner on the shelf), SliceStack (thousands of slices as a ream), ReportPrinter (a printer whose page DOES arrive, late; ResultTray's empty tray is the opposite), Scoreboard (lit rows and a dashed blank row, with an optional taped flap), GurneyToken (a patient marker with no vehicle), WallPhone (no phone on the shelf); all in lib/ping.tsx
casting.shelf: Stopwatch (lib/groundstop.tsx) the throughline; MapBoard + AK_PATH (lib/serum.tsx) for the Alaska map, Utqiagvik to Juneau; Suit (lib/people.tsx) faceless for Kelly Isaacs with a boxed name card; Odometer (lib/sonar) for the brain-cell counter; StrikeProp, IdleFigure, FigureFinish, HeldTravel, HeldProp from the house kit
casting.never: no face on any real person, no ambulance, plane or helicopter, no specialists on the map (they stand on a WHOLE STATE card off the map), no hospital or grantee named, no logo, the six hospitals never in one town
casting.shelf_check: grepped ASSET_INDEX.md and lib/ for scanner, CT, printer, phone, scoreboard, gurney, reticle, stamp, hand, door, banner: no CT scanner, no report printer, no wall or desk phone, no outcomes scoreboard and no gurney exist; FieldRadiograph is a portable X-ray, ResultTray (serum) is a results printer whose tray stays EMPTY by contract, which is the opposite of the gag; SearchReticle (vision.tsx) exists and is reused for the lock; the kit Stamp exists but the board no longer stamps; IdleFigure wraps the five specialists; Stopwatch (groundstop), MapBoard's AK_PATH, Suit, Odometer and the house rigs are reused
casting.throughline_rule: case 1's stopwatch stays at 0:00 and never runs; only case 2's runs; Ping never touches the stopwatch until it carries it into Anchorage as a courier (S11), and never takes credit for the time

motion_language: Ping moves with springs: it is born with a squash-and-pop, flags with an anticipation lean, splits like a cell (stretch, neck, snap, two copies overshoot apart), slumps when the doctor's hand rolls it a half turn and its glow drains to grey. The printer lives ONLY at the second hospital's desk and starts at the man's arrival (46 s): one page creeping out at a constant crawl, so the phone call beating it is the joke. The stopwatch sweep runs continuously while the man's clock runs. Earned motion blur on the two copies streaking across the map and on the stopwatch hand at the 4 HR 23 MIN freeze. Camera kicks only on 3 board-flagged beats. The doctor's hand rolls Ping a half turn and its glow drains to graphite grey. In the second case the pulse down the phone cord is bone, never orchid: the call is the nurse's.

composition.focal_hierarchy: Ping first, then the number it carries, then the room
composition.negative_space: the dark window wall above the CT ring and the blank scoreboard rows are deliberate quiet
composition.safe_area: heroes and plates inside y 420 to 1500 of the 9:16 for the square crop; the top band holds the window wall and the stopwatch, the band under the caption bar holds the near counter, the cart or the desk edge, varied by act; feet and labels above y 1290
composition.signature_shot: THE SPLIT RACE (S10): a locked split with a hard centre seam. Left, cold graphite-teal snow under a navy sky, three outlined gurney tokens crawling three converging abstract dashed distance lines (no road surface, shoulders or tracks) with a small DISTANCE tick scale; one token stalls at a tick for a beat. Right, the warm buttercream Anchorage room with the TRANSFER CALL note already on its door, three light snaps timed to beat 24, gowns dropping onto hooks, the early-data plate swinging, then the lead token crosses the seam into a room that is ready, held 1.5 s. S9's stopwatch stop is staged medium with no kick so S10 is the act's one full-frame graphic event.

craft_advance: none required beyond the net-new Ping family; engine advances go to the weekly machine pass
